source_datasets.notes: Table 2.5.1 prints one-decimal percentages for four religion categories (2008 heads: Buddhist, Muslims, Christians, Other; 2019 heads: Buddhist, Muslims, Christian, Other) by province for 2008 and 2019 on the current 25-province frame. The 2008 block is NIS's own retabulation onto the current frame, with Tbong Khmum (created 2013) shown separately. No source publishes religion counts by province; percentages only are extracted.

source_datasets.notes: Table A4 national counts (Buddhism 15,096,757; Islam 317,649; Christianity 49,160; Other 85,443; Not Stated 3,202) sum to 15,552,211 exactly. Re-based to exclude Not Stated (basis 15,549,009), the four categories round to 97.1/2.0/0.3/0.5, matching the Table 2.5.1 national row. Used as the national count anchor; its five-category label set (Buddhism, Islam, Christianity, Other, Not Stated) is the count-anchor frame and is not applied to the Table 2.5.1 source fields.

indicators.label: Buddhist (%)
indicators.description: The Buddhist (reference-group) share: the share of the re-based four-category frame reporting Buddhist, relabelled verbatim on the page as “Buddhist (%)”. This slot names the reference group and carries its share of the frame; it is never a measure of affiliation versus non-affiliation.
indicators.method: Two-slot minority-share design (minority-share-metric.md, ratified 2026-07-11, PI task 6). The reference group is Buddhist, the product's largest published category at the national level in the most recent wave (2019: 97.1 percent, from the Table A4 counts re-based to exclude Not Stated, reproducing the Table 2.5.1 national row), declared once and held constant across every wave and area. This slot carries that reference group's share of the frame in each province and wave (the printed Table 2.5.1 Buddhist cell). National 2019 reference share: 97.1.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty-five ADM1 provinces on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both census waves (2008 retabulated onto the same 25-province frame).
indicators.quality_notes: Printed one-decimal cells; the four categories sum to 99.9-100.1 by rounding, within the derived 0.20 pp bound, and no percentage is altered. The Buddhist share is the exact complement of the minority share carried in no_religion_percent; the two sum to 100.0 in every row.

indicators.label: Minority share (%)
indicators.description: The minority share: the summed share of every published category outside the reference group (Muslims, Christians, Other). Relabelled verbatim on the page as “Minority share (%)”, with the note “share outside Cambodia's largest published category, Buddhist”. It reuses the no_religion_percent slot and is not a measure of no religion.
indicators.method: Arithmetic on published affiliation categories: the exact complement of the Buddhist reference share (100 minus the Buddhist share), equal at the source's one-decimal rounding to the summed Muslims/Christians/Other share. It is not a measure of no religion, belief, practice, or secularity.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty-five ADM1 provinces on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both census waves (2008 retabulated onto the same 25-province frame).
indicators.quality_notes: Reuses the no_religion_percent slot for the minority-share construct (the Israel two-slot precedent); the re-based frame has no no-religion category. Highest where the map is most informative (2019: Mondul Kiri 29.6, Ratanak Kiri 26.6, Tbong Khmum 11.9).

indicators.label: Change in the Buddhist share, 2008-2019
indicators.description: Cross-wave change in the Buddhist (reference-group) share on the shared 25-province frame.
indicators.method: Difference of the 2008 and 2019 Buddhist reference share (carried in religious_affiliation_percent and in each row's quality_flag composition) on the shared re-based frame. Withheld for Mondul Kiri and Ratanak Kiri, whose large Other (highland indigenous) share shifts the 2019 report attributes to reclassification; those rows carry change_withheld_reclassification_highland_other_share.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty-five ADM1 provinces on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary, shared by both census waves (2008 retabulated onto the same 25-province frame).
indicators.quality_notes: The reference share varies across waves, so headline change is a real quantity (the change in the largest group's share), differenced for 23 provinces and withheld for the two highland provinces.

visual_layers.label: Buddhist (%)
visual_layers.description: Buddhist (reference-group) share by province, 2008 and 2019 (NIS 2019 census Table 2.5.1).
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published province value on the shared 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: The religious_affiliation_percent slot carries the Buddhist reference-group share (minority-share design); the page relabels it verbatim as “Buddhist (%)”. It is the exact complement of the minority-share layer.

visual_layers.label: Minority share (%)
visual_layers.description: Minority share by province (share outside Cambodia's largest published category, Buddhist), 2008 and 2019.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published province value on the shared 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: The no_religion_percent slot carries the minority share (the summed Muslims/ Christians/Other share, the exact complement of the Buddhist share); the page relabels it verbatim as “Minority share (%)”. It is not a measure of no religion. Highest where the map is most informative (2019: Mondul Kiri 29.6, Ratanak Kiri 26.6, Tbong Khmum 11.9).
